title: Transition from Sukha Singh’s Escape to the Parol–Kathua Survivors

blocks.text: This page finishes the escape after the slaughter by describing the Singhs crossing into Majha after forcing their way through the river country. They move through the hot Jaito tract, gather again in the jungle, and tend Sukha Singh’s shattered leg while the survivors pause to recover after months of strain.

The repair notes that Sukha Singh remained laid up for many months while the rest of the band slowly reorganized itself. The scene is less about triumph than endurance, showing how a broken remnant kept itself alive after the massacre.

The page then turns into a hinge and opens the next episode by returning to the survivors left at Parol and Kathua. Some men tried horses, others tried the hills, but every line of retreat was narrowing under pursuit from Lakhpat Rai’s side and from hostile country around them.
